claims.statement: For every finite ordinary tree T and natural p<=7 with x(T)+2<=p and 3p<2alpha(T)+1, the complete sum over original leaves v with Delta_p(T-v)<0 of Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s_v})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s_v]) is nonpositive.
claims.scope: Ranks p=3..7; all nonempty ordinary trees at those eligible ranks. The argument reduces p=3..5 to the marked-isolate order band and p=6..7 to five exact residual census slices after applying the registered first-descent forest maxima. Census-dependent bounded-computation scope only; no p>=8 or governed-tree assertion.
claims.reason: The rank/order split is exhaustive if the registered M(1..5) values and 4k global order bound and the informal marked-isolate order-band lemma are admitted at their stated grades. All five residual outputs report exact complete sums strictly negative, with every eligible row subset-replayed; the order-17/18 scope-label correction is identified and applied. This supports only the stated census-dependent composition. Full generators were not rerun in this seat and the universal primary status remains open to controller review.

limitations: The order-band lemma is informal and was audited from its stated proof, not formally verified here.
M(1..5) and the five residual slices retain their bounded-computation grades; the full tree generators were not rerun in this seat.
The composition establishes no conclusion for p>=8, the all-rank primary, or governed-tree transport.
